rules.statement: The club hourly rate must be a whole number of cents and cannot be negative.
rules.subject: club rate (cents per hour)

evidence.quote: if (input.end <= input.start) throw new DomainError("validation", "end must be after start");

rules.statement: A club booking's end time must be after its start time.
rules.subject: club booking end time

rules.statement: A club booking cannot overlap in time with another club booking on the same date that uses any of the same rink halves.
rules.subject: club booking time slot and rink half

evidence.quote: throw new DomainError("validation", "rink must be \"whole\" or \"half\"");

rules.statement: A club booking must be for either the whole rink or half the rink. A half-rink booking must name half "a" or half "b".
rules.subject: club booking rink selection

rules.statement: Each club booking keeps the club hourly rate in effect when it was booked, and the monthly invoice charges at that stored rate.
rules.subject: club booking rate

rules.statement: On the monthly club invoice, booked hours are charged at the booking's hourly rate. A half-rink booking is charged at 50% of that rate, and each line amount is rounded to the nearest cent.
rules.subject: half-rink invoice charge share
